messages:
morgan_cs: Heads-up — need to rejig tomorrow's enablement office hours. A few renewal-risk accounts asked for a dedicated migration walkthrough (NovaHealth, Lumen). Can we pivot agenda to a Migration + KV-cache deduping deep-dive? Need an eng presenter. cc @henry_se
henry_se: I can do the runtime/config portion for ~25m, but need a quick slide deck and any non-prod demo creds. @nina_ps can you run the demo?
nina_ps: Yep I can demo. Prefer slot at 11:30–12:15 PT so I can spin up a fresh env. I'll need the migration sample dataset and any blocked APIs documented.
aj_sales: Prioritize NovaHealth and Lumen in invites — both have QBRs next week and asked specifically. Can we add a 1:1 followup poll for renewal owners?
morgan_cs: Good call. Proposed agenda (short):
```
Agenda:
- 11:30 intro & goals (5m)
- 11:35 migration deep dive (25m) — Henry
- 12:00 demo + Q&A (20m) — Nina
- 12:20 triage & next steps (10m)
```
Also propose a 15m post-session triage slot to assign actions to account owners.
olivia_ops: I'll update the calendar invite now and attach the pre-read. Pre-read link: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/migration-primer (please check access).
morgan_cs: Prework: ask attendees to fill this quick intake before the session so we can prioritize— https://forms.gle/enablement-intake-2026. Add a check "have non-prod creds?" so demo planning is smoother.
cs-bot: :bell: Reminder scheduled — Zoom ID 123-456-789, dial-in +1 415 555 0100. Room reserved for 11:20–12:40 PT.
trevor_support: I'll own taking live notes and capturing action items in the shared doc. Link I'll paste in the invite comments. Can someone volunteer to triage follow-ups after the call?
sophia_pm: I'll own NovaHealth follow-ups (renewal owner). If someone else can grab Lumen, we're good.
morgan_cs: Thanks all — volunteers: Henry (presenter), Nina (demo), Trevor (notes), Sophia (NovaHealth follow-ups). Need owner for Lumen follow-ups. @aj_sales can you assign or nominate? :thumbsup:
aj_sales: I can take Lumen follow-ups or loop in Raj. Taking it for now. :thumbsup:
morgan_cs: Sweet. Olivia — once calendar updated, ping this thread and I'll post a final attendee list + timezone-friendly view. Also we'll add a short 3-question feedback form to capture clarity, blockers, and next requests.
olivia_ops: Calendar updated, invite sent to prioritized list, pre-read attached, and form link added. I pinned the invite to the team channel too.
morgan_cs: Great — final check: slides by EOD please. Henry/Nina ping me when ready so I can QA the flow. If anything blocks, drop here. :rocket:
